records.purpose: Check verified backend admission and current pool lifetime.
records.buffer_contract:
`sco_result (*is_ready)(sco_plugin* self);`
Check verified backend admission and current pool lifetime.
records.ownership: Caller owns all buffers and output records. No engine pointer or caller buffer is retained.
records.thread_affinity: Game thread only; self must be live.
records.callback_context: No plugin callbacks; synchronous host backend calls only.
records.results: OK completed; BAD_ARG invalid owner, type, extent or range; WRONG_THREAD off game thread; UNAVAILABLE absent backend, admission, lifetime or write permission; NOT_FOUND missing record; FAILED backend fault.
records.absent_capability: No native backend is supplied. Verified callbacks, fresh offline admission and ready lifetime are required; writes additionally default OFF.
records.cleanup: Stop withdraws the table and clears callbacks and write permission. Backend faults latch unavailable until process restart.
limitations: No native game pool adapter is supplied.
C++/C#/Lua typed wrappers are unsupported; C table access is supported.
